claims.statement: `ygg-core` may depend only on serde, serde_json and thiserror; a VM, schema validator, IO or platform API inside it breaks the kernel's determinism guarantee.
`ygg-lint` carries no `ygg-*` kernel dependency, which keeps static AST checks buildable without `mlua` or the store.
SQLite reaches the CLI only through dev-dependencies of the native host binary, so `ygg-wasm` and `ygg-lint` dependency trees stay free of `rusqlite` and filesystem crates.
`ygg-sim` depends on no other `ygg-*` crate and only on `thiserror` at runtime, so it can compile to `wasm32-unknown-unknown` and reach the browser via `ygg-wasm → ygg-sandbox → ygg-sim`.
Resource-format contracts live only in `packages/schema/schemas/`, read by both the TypeScript (ajv) and Rust (jsonschema) sides; an inline copy on either side is the drift this rule forbids.
